fact: MoRENet's new border PoP in Cape Town interconnects with South Africa's TENET and SANReN to carry Mozambique's expanded 60 Gbps international capacity, which MoRENet staff described as ready and operational.

WACREN reports that its network is directly interconnected with the ZAOXI exchange point in Cape Town through South Africa's SANReN and TENET over a new 10 Gbps Lagos-Cape Town link, announced on 17 October 2025.
